bullets: Added a hidden upgrade button feature that hides the upgrade offer when your account has enough access.
Prevented long sessions from forgetting instructions by preserving your original prompts and to-do list.
Added a new deals command to the CLI that displays sponsor offers, which is disabled by default.
Prevented the assistant from freezing by limiting any single reply to one hundred tool actions.
Fixed a rare error where the assistant could not continue a conversation after a very long task.
Updated the website busy error message to include a direct support email address.
Removed personal conversation details from crash reports before sending them to company servers.
Changed how question cards are handled to prevent stale or confusing replies if the connection drops.
Restored the terminal assistant's text display method after a recent performance update caused delays.
Reverted the terminal assistant's message pagination to fifteen items for a larger viewing window.
Updated the get-started page to guide new users to a direct desktop download instead of copying commands.
Added ad conversion tracking tools that monitor automated coding task setups.
Saved a snapshot of project file structures for a few minutes to speed up ad placement.
